card.name: Dose ranges and prescriber wording
card.fires_on: The word "to" between two radioactivity amounts (MBq), the space before a dose limit number, and the middle or end of "prescriber" in warnings.

modes.label: Range "to" in MBq doses
modes.description: The word "to" joining two MBq amounts in an injected radioactivity dose range.

modes.label: Prescriber instructions
modes.description: Inside the word prescriber(s) when a sentence tells prescribers to take something into account.
modes.example: prescri<<bers>> should continually reassess patients for drows

modes.label: Space before rate limit
modes.description: A blank space just before a number giving a maximum infusion rate.
modes.example: DO NOT exceed an infusion rate of:<< >>200 mg/minute in adult

card.writes: It lowers words about advice and recommendations, so the text moves on to the dose or rule itself.
card.plain: It fires on dose-range wording and on the word prescriber, where the label is about to give a number or an instruction.
